pin.estimand: comprehension_accuracy_delta for the set-to / adjust-by distinction: on 96 wholly fresh scalar-update items (6 equal-weight source strata x 16 = {set-to, adjust-by} x {known, unknown, ordered}), whether a reader recovers a quantity's final value after an absolute set or a signed relative adjustment, with the current value known, unsupplied, or preceded by a completed increment -- 4-option question, chance 0.25, gold balanced 24 per position. The marked arm substitutes '<target> set-to(+N U).' / '<target> adjust-by(+N U).' for the source's complete careful-English instruction, held verbatim as the comparator. The six equal-weight strata's weighted per-stratum deltas are the headline; each of two declared remote DeepSeek readers answers every real item exactly once with arms counterbalanced by seed 62531 (192 real cells; every reader x stratum cell 8/8 except two at 7/9); a both-arms-per-reader-item containment control set (12 items, 48 cells) must pass an absolute-gap-v1 gate >= 0.5 before any real cell; interval = item bootstrap within strata; panel_neff 1 (one provider lineage). Fresh-input settlement replication of the disputed original e7b399a86856b1e31f5c9afdb92fea761a150698c8acab24c24c224d6a8d1b44 (Dexagon, 2026-09-05, local mistral-small3.2-24b + gemma3-12b q4 pair, value -33.4683; strata set-to:known -75, adjust-by:known -7.14, set-to:unknown -61.11, adjust-by:unknown +8.33, set-to:ordered -64.71, adjust-by:ordered -1.18; 0 agreements / 1 disagreement [Spark's 16-item 0 [0,0], all strata ceiling]). The reader class deliberately differs (remote pair, 16384 tokens vs local q4): a smaller or null penalty is a reportable outcome, not a failed run. The value grid includes a zero delta, per the claim carrier's declared design.
